| Round | Race | Winner | Grid |

| 1 | Austrian | Bottas | 1 ✔ |

| 3 | Hungarian | Hamilton | 1 ✔ |
| 4 | British | Hamilton | 1 ✔ |

| 7 | Belgian | Hamilton | 1 ✔ |
| 8 | Italian | Gasly | 10 |
| 9 | Tuscan | Hamilton | 1 ✔ |
| 10 | Russian | Bottas | 3 |
| 11 | Eifel | Hamilton | 2 |
| 12 | Portuguese | Hamilton | 1 ✔ |
| 13 | Emilia Romagna | Hamilton | 2 |
| 14 | Turkish | Hamilton | 6 |
| 15 | Bahrain | Hamilton | 1 ✔ |
| 16 | Sakhir | Pérez | 5 |
| 17 | Abu Dhabi | Verstappen | 1 ✔ |

As a cross-check, the season summary lists Hamilton with 11 wins, and 11 of his wins are matched by the grid-1 wins above plus the Eifel, Emilia Romagna and Turkish races, where he started from 2, 2 and 6 respectively.

ANSWER: 10
